responsibility: This definition module exposes a small ADDRESS-list abstraction built as an appendable, iterable container with duplicate-aware insertion helpers. It is the public interface for alists, used where mc needs a simple list of pointers with sequential access, membership tests, removal, and duplication, without exposing the chunked linked-list representation used internally.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the alists stem, exposing the alist type and list operations without revealing representation; the same-named .mod file contains the chunked linked-list structure and the actual append/search/remove/copy code.
